titolo: Printable Pirate Coloring Pages for Kids, 24 Page PDF Coloring Book, Instant Download, Treasure Map Pirate Ship, Ages 4-8
descrizione:
Ahoy, little adventurers! A pirate and treasure island printable coloring book with 24 big, simple pages: a friendly young captain, pirate ships, a parrot on a treasure chest, a treasure map with a big X, a waving sea monster, a pirate cat, a whale, a sunken ship and a campfire night on the island. Thick, clear outlines and large areas make it easy and relaxing to color, and the first page says THIS BOOK BELONGS TO, ready for a name.

WHAT YOU GET
- 1 PDF in US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and 1 PDF in A4 (21 x 29.7 cm)
- 25 pages: a full-colour cover + 24 black and white coloring pages, one big illustration per page
- 300 DPI, thick clear outlines, easy to color for kids aged about 4 to 8

HOW IT WORKS
This is a digital download: no physical item will be shipped. After payment, download the files from your Etsy account (Purchases) and print them at home or at a print shop on plain white paper, as many times as you like for your own family.

PERSONAL USE ONLY: please do not resell, share or redistribute the files or the printed pages.

Prefer a ready printed book? Each book is also available as a printed soft cover coloring book, made in the USA: see our Coloring Books section.
